title: Exec office hours — prep & quick Q&A skeleton (scratch)
content:
Purpose / outcome (short):
- 30–45 minute office hours: lightweight, approachable channel for teams to surface blockers, ask directional product questions, and understand what leadership is hearing.
- Primary goal for this session: lower friction for surfaced repos/issues that need exec attention; collect noisy signals into two action buckets (immediate unblock / longer-term input).

Audience & tone:
- Mostly ICs + managers who gravitate to synchronous exec access; keep tone candid + pragmatic. Avoid deep product justifications — aim for clarity, next steps, and owners.

Logistics (working assumptions):
- When: Thursday 11:00–11:45 PT (1st slot after weekly wrap). Reserve Zoom link + slack thread pinned.
- Format: 5 min opening (CEO), 25–30 min open Q&A (no slide deck), 5–10 min closing and actions (COO/Head of Eng).
- RSVP: optional; encourage posting 1–2 bullet questions in thread ahead of time to help triage.

Announcement draft (Slack/Email) — quick, raw:
--- slack copy (work-in-progress) ---
Hey team — Rachel here. We’re running a short exec office hours slot this Thursday 11am PT. No slides, bring questions. If you have something you’d like to ensure we address, drop 1–2 bullets in the thread (or DM me). We’ll capture owners and follow-ups in the pinned notes.
Purpose: unblock and amplify work that needs leadership context.
See you there.
--- end ---

Quick checklist before go-live:
- Confirm Zoom link and co-host handoff (Ops) — Samir to set 24h before.
- Create thread and pin in #all-hands + #eng (Inez will post).
- Preload 3 sample questions to avoid early silence.
- Sticky doc for actions (confluence stub linked above). Owner: Rachel.

Talking points for CEO (raw prompts / things to call out):
- Quick framing: why office hours exist (democratize access, surface blockers, hear unused signals).
- High-level company health: growth signal, usage anecdotes (1-2 lines), no new major outages to call out.
- Reassure on runway/exec priorities: shipping predictability > chasing many initiatives; prioritization tradeoffs and how teams can push for a slot at planning reviews.
- Ops ask: tell people exactly how to escalate (link escalation doc).

Anticipated question bank (prep answers + escalation path):
1) Q: Dedicated capacity latency spike — will we give credits / how do we communicate?
   A (short): investigating, SRE/Infra lead to post RCA timeline within 48h; interim mitigation = route customers to fallback model variants. Eskalation: create JIRA/PAGE, assign to infra-sre.
2) Q: Private deployment onboarding speed — ETA for VPC templates?
   A (short): templates in internal beta; expected wider availability Q1 next release; get on waiting list via solutions-eng.
3) Q: Pricing ask — can we do trial for large customer?
   A (short): Pricing team owns pilot credits; route to sales-eng; quick triage call within 3 business days.
4) Q: Model retirement policy — will we be forced to upgrade?
   A: Policy still under discussion; short answer: 90d deprecation with migration plan and support windows. Link to draft policy.
5) Q: Observability retention — can my team get longer traces?
   A: Premium retention is an add-on; open a support ticket and tag "trace-retention"; product will review use-case for exceptions.

Notes-to-self / red flags to surface if asked:
- Any mention of "sudden cost increase" from customers = high priority (coordinate with billing).
- If a customer cites wrong inference outputs / hallucination regression tied to a deployed model (hosted/dedicated) — trigger a cross-team triage (Applied ML + Product + Support).

Action capture template (quick):
- Issue / topic: short line
- Owner: name + team
- ETA / next step: e.g., post update to thread, schedule deep-dive, open JIRA ID

Live facilitation tips (scratch):
- If silence > 60s after open prompt, call on 1–2 folks who pre-posted questions.
- Keep responses to 90s for execs; deeper dive => create follow-up slot with SME.
- Call out when an issue will be documented vs when it requires a cross-functional meeting.

Post-session follow-up (day0–3):
- Within 24h: post notes + owner list in slack thread.
- Within 72h: owners to update Confluence + JIRA for any follow-ups.

Open questions (for Samir / Inez):
- Do we want to make recordings available? pros/cons re: candidness. (Samir preference = audio off by default unless presenter opts in)
- Should we rotate moderator role across execs or keep stable? Recommend rotating monthly; lower friction for different SLAs.

TODO (personal):
- Draft 2-line announcement for #eng and #all-hands (Inez to post) — due Wed EOD.
- Confirm co-host on Zoom + set recording policy — Samir.
- Bake a short escalation flow diagram into the Confluence stub.

Quick links I keep referencing:
- Escalation doc: https://redwood-confluence.company/incidents/escalation
- Office hours stub: https://redwood-confluence.company/exec/office-hours-agenda
- Internal pilot list (solutions-eng): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pilotX

Rough closing script (CEO):
"Thanks — this was helpful. We’ll capture owners now and follow up in-thread. If this raised a blocker for your team, please flag it in the thread and we’ll prioritize a triage. Appreciate you taking the time; we’ll run these weekly and iterate."

End of scratchpad.

Notes: keep this light, rework into polished announcement tomorrow.
